title: MLC Conjecture
exact_target: Does every point of the Mandelbrot set have arbitrarily small connected neighborhoods within the Mandelbrot set?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 1338 (DYN-002). CC BY 4.0.
Dierk Schleicher, \emph{On Fibers and Local Connectivity of Mandelbrot and Multibrot Sets} (1999), arXiv:math/9902155v1, Sections 1--2.
